argv: --title=Carry cloud-session Beads writes to the canonical database (bd outbox)

--description=Repo process (user call 2026-10-16), not track-tooling. Cloud sessions cannot push the Beads Dolt remote; until now cloud agents wrote ad hoc migration scripts or JSONL for the user to run locally, which collide on IDs of issues the session created, are not safe to rerun, and have no fixed way to reach the dev machine.

Scope: host/tools/bd_outbox.py records every Beads write a cloud session makes in .beads/outbox/<branch>.jsonl (committed with the branch) and replays the outboxes on the dev machine, mapping session-created IDs to canonical ones and keeping progress so a rerun is safe; offline tests in host/tests; AGENTS.md cloud-session rules; guidance for a cloud environment setup script so sessions start with bd, the ARM toolchain and STM32CubeH7 FatFs.

--acceptance=Offline tests pass; an outbox recorded in a cloud session applies to a fresh copy of the canonical database with remapped IDs, and a rerun applies nothing; AGENTS.md documents the cloud rules and the local apply; the user applies the first real outbox on the dev machine.

2026-10-16 (Claude, cloud session): branch claude/beads-outbox from main b97fcfa.
